mentions.name: Algorithmic Font Effects Tool
mentions.description: A Python tool that takes OTF/TTF font files, applies algorithmic effects to them, and exports a new OTF/TTF font ready to use in design work, websites, and other creative projects.
mentions.problem: The author wanted interesting-looking typefaces for printmaking assignments while taking studio art classes at university.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got laid off so I'm dusting off an old python project that takes OTF/TFF files and applies algorithmic effects to them. Then you can export the font as a new OTF/TFF file to unleash on your own design work, websites, etc.

evidence.value: I got laid off so I'm dusting off an old python project that takes OTF/TFF files and applies algorithmic effects to them. Then you can export the font as a new OTF/TFF file to unleash on your own design work, websites, etc.
